item.title: qemu-wasm: full virtual machines inside your browser
item.description: qemu-wasm ports QEMU to WebAssembly to boot a full x86_64 virtual machine inside the browser. trynix.dev runs any nixpkgs package from the last 13 years, and a GitHub Action boots a PR's build from a single link.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Rust eBooks Nightly — Rust books in EPUB, AZW3, MOBI, and PDF
item.description: Artur Sulej's project that automatically builds and publishes the latest versions of top Rust books as eBooks. Updated daily.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
